'''Veek''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he tasked a Republic hero to test out his new modified ion gun on some nearby droids.
